answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy asks each newcomer to join a sonnet-ranked reef of bonded identities, with the bond frozen for 28 epochs. Two randomly chosen auditors replay every task; a failed replay burns 18 percent. A trellis sponsor limit permits just two fresh identities per epoch, and peers cross-check signed output fingerprints so copycat clusters get quarantined. Seven clean rounds unlock payouts, making clones expensive and slow while task hashes keep the trail verifiable.
